+name: LUMO grades 1-4 learning source audit
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [chatgpt/lumo-learning-curriculum-audit-20261114, repair/lumo-2020-exact-learning-20261114]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: lumo-learning-audit-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+jobs:
+  core-learning:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 35
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
+        with:
+          flutter-version: '3.44.9'
+          channel: stable
+          cache: true
+      - name: Resolve existing locked Flutter dependencies
+        run: flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile
+      - name: Test shape tracing, retry and single-pointer ink handling
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p audit/learning-all-grades
+          flutter test --no-pub --no-test-assets test/shape_trace_input_regression_test.dart test/shape_trace_retry_test.dart test/lumo_ink_surface_regression_test.dart --reporter=expanded 2>&1 | tee audit/learning-all-grades/shape-input-tests.log
+      - name: Test production topic selection, repeated reading and level changes
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          flutter test --no-pub test/learning_selection_integration_test.dart --reporter=expanded 2>&1 | tee audit/learning-all-grades/production-selection-tests.log
+      - name: Test exact selection without changing legacy callers
+        run: flutter test --no-pub test/learning/learning_exact_selection_test.dart --reporter=expanded
+      - name: Sample every registered current-grade core lesson family
+        run: dart run tools/audit_learning_tasks_all_grades.dart audit/learning-all-grades
+      - name: Preserve task-family rows and all observed failures
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: lumo-learning-grades1-4-sampled-contracts
+          path: audit/learning-all-grades/
+          if-no-files-found: warn
+          retention-days: 30
+
+  connect-four-flutter:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
+        with:
+          flutter-version: '3.44.9'
+          channel: stable
+          cache: true
+      - name: Resolve existing locked Flutter dependencies
+        run: flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile
+      - name: Test complete C4 gameplay and five actual layout sizes
+        env:
+          LUMO_CONNECT_CAPTURES: audit/connect-four/captures
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p audit/connect-four
+          touch_status=0
+          flutter test --no-pub --reporter=expanded --timeout=60s \
+            test/games/games_screen_flow_test.dart --plain-name 'Four in a row' \
+            2>&1 | tee audit/connect-four/touch-game.log || touch_status=$?
+          layout_status=0
+          flutter test --no-pub --reporter=expanded --timeout=60s \
+            test/design/connect_four_visual_test.dart test/games/connect_four_fold_controls_test.dart \
+            2>&1 | tee audit/connect-four/layouts.log || layout_status=$?
+          if [ "$touch_status" -ne 0 ] || [ "$layout_status" -ne 0 ]; then
+            printf 'C4 focused checks failed: gameplay=%s layouts=%s\n' "$touch_status" "$layout_status" >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+      - name: Preserve original C4 logs and genuine renders
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: lumo-agent-c4-flutter
+          path: audit/connect-four/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30
